data.title: Added To Wardrobe

selected_item.promptDescription: This trench coat features a double-breasted front with two rows of four buttons each, secured by a wide, matching belt with a rectangular buckle at the waist. The coat has a notched lapel collar with a single vent on each side of the front opening. Shoulder epaulets are present, and the sleeves are long with adjustable straps and buckles at the cuffs. The garment includes two large, angled patch pockets on the front, positioned below the belt line. The outerwear length is partially visible, extending below the hips. Seams are visible along the shoulders, sides, and pockets, contributing to the structured silhouette. The material appears smooth, with a slight sheen, and the overall construction emphasizes clean lines and functional detailing
